scope: Supplementary Table S17. Seed 0. Fixed matched observations, clocks, and spatial references.
rule: Keep a prediction-box pair only when the projected BEVHeight point lies in exactly one retained GT-matched detector box and that box contains no other BEVHeight prediction point in the same camera and frame. The subset is not chosen by GT error.
scoring: No training and no tracking replay. HSG, seed-0 HSG-SRL, and BEVHeight use the same retained observations. HSG-SRL is the overlap-gated localizer; on M6 the eligible cameras are C05, C06, and C07.
